# google_discovery_engine_project_provision

Provisions a Google Cloud project for Discovery Engine and prepares and initializes related systems.


To get more information about ProjectProvision, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects/provision)

~> **Warning:** This resource is create-only and cannot be read, updated, or deleted from the API.
Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state without unprovisioning the Google Cloud project.


## Example Usage - Discoveryengine Project Provision Basic


```hcl
resource "google_project" "project" {
  project_id      = "example"
  name            = "example"
  org_id          = "123456789"
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

resource "google_project_service" "discoveryengine" {
  project            = google_project.project.project_id
  service            = "discoveryengine.googleapis.com"
  disable_on_destroy = false
}

resource "time_sleep" "wait_enable_service_api" {
  depends_on      = [google_project_service.discoveryengine]
  create_duration = "30s"
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_project_provision" "default" {
  project                = google_project.project.project_id
  accept_data_use_terms  = true
  data_use_terms_version = "2022-11-23"

  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_enable_service_api]
}
```

## Example Usage - Discoveryengine Project Provision Saas Params


```hcl
resource "google_project" "project" {
  project_id      = "saas-prj"
  name            = "saas-prj"
  org_id          = "123456789"
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

resource "google_project_service" "discoveryengine" {
  project            = google_project.project.project_id
  service            = "discoveryengine.googleapis.com"
  disable_on_destroy = false
}

resource "time_sleep" "wait_enable_service_api" {
  depends_on      = [google_project_service.discoveryengine]
  create_duration = "30s"
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_project_provision" "saas" {
  project  = google_project.project.project_id
  location = "global"

  saas_params {
    is_biz = true
  }

  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_enable_service_api]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `accept_data_use_terms` -
  (Optional)
  Set to `true` to specify that the caller has read and consents to the
  [Terms for data use](https://cloud.google.com/retail/data-use-terms).

* `data_use_terms_version` -
  (Optional)
  The version of the [Terms for data use](https://cloud.google.com/retail/data-use-terms)
  that the caller has read and consents to. An acceptable version is `2022-11-23`,
  and this may change over time.

* `saas_params` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters for Gemini Enterprise (Agentspace) provisioning.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_saas_params).

* `location` -
  (Optional)
  The geographic location in which to provision the project, such as
  `global`, `us`, or `eu`.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_saas_params"></a>The `saas_params` block supports:

* `accept_biz_qos` -
  (Optional)
  Set to `true` to specify that the caller has read and consents to the
  Terms for business edition quality of service.

* `is_biz` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the current request is for Business edition (`true`)
  or not (`false`).

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}`
